SELECT product_name, code_number, specification, type, ROUND(price, 2) AS price FROM ${table} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND product_name IS NOT NULL AND product_name != '' AND LOWER(product_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{w}), '%')
ORDER BY (LOWER(product_name) = LOWER(#{full})) DESC, date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT product_name, product_code AS code_number, specification, category AS type, price FROM stock_data WHERE product_name IS NOT NULL AND product_name != '' AND LOWER(product_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{w}), '%')
ORDER BY (LOWER(product_name) = LOWER(#{full})) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
